note: North Carolina U.S. Senate race, researched Oct. 25, 2026.

candidates.name: Roy Cooper
candidates.bio: Governor of North Carolina from 2017 to 2025 and state attorney general from 2001 to 2017.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper vetoed North Carolina's 12-week abortion ban (S 20, 2023)
source.quote: to keep politicians out of the doctor's exam room

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper called the 12-week ban dangerous for women (CNN, 2023)
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper ordered state greenhouse gas cuts of at least 50% below 2005 levels by 2030 and net zero by 2050
source.quote: The urgency of the climate crisis is real.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper set goals of 2.8 gigawatts of offshore wind by 2030 and 8 by 2040 (Executive Order 218)
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper vetoed a bill limiting wetlands protections (S 582, 2023) and re-established a state environmental justice board
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper created North Carolina's first Community Violence Prevention Strategic Plan (2024)
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper supports stronger antitrust rules and banning algorithms that raise grocery prices
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper supports child care subsidies for employees
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper vetoed the private school voucher expansion (H 10, 2024) and wants a moratorium on vouchers
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper expanded Medicaid to more than 600,000 North Carolinians and would reverse the federal Medicaid cuts
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper would restore the ACA tax credits
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper would cap prescription drug costs
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper vetoed bills requiring sheriffs to work with ICE on jail inmates (2019, 2022, 2024) and wants ICE reforms before more funding
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper says Congress should take back its constitutional authority to declare war
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper is deeply concerned about the reasons for the Iran war and its exit strategy
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper praises unions but signed 2017 limits on farmworker union representation (S 615)
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper vetoed the ban on gender transition care for minors (H 808, 2023)

guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper vetoed bills limiting transgender sports participation and transition care (2023) and as attorney general refused to defend the 2016 bathroom bill
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper supported raising North Carolina's minimum wage (2019) and proposed $15 an hour for school support staff
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper opposed further income tax cuts for corporations and high earners
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper vetoed a voter ID bill (S 824, 2018)
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Cooper vetoed added absentee voting restrictions (S 747, 2023)

candidates.name: Michael Whatley
candidates.bio: Chair of the Republican National Committee from 2024 to 2025 and a former chair of the North Carolina Republican Party.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Whatley on abortion (USA Today, 2024)
source.quote: proud to be the most pro-life chair in the history of the Republican Party

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Whatley called the veto of North Carolina's 12-week ban the radical abortion-on-demand position
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Whatley backs an all-of-the-above energy approach and lobbied for offshore drilling off North Carolina
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: As an energy industry lobbyist, Whatley sought to limit air pollution rules and called EPA air provisions an unfunded mandate (2014)
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Whatley would put more police on the street and pay them better
source.quote: We need to back the blue.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Whatley would create a federal version of Iryna's Law, limiting pretrial release for people accused of violent crimes
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Whatley supports the 2025 law's cuts to Medicaid and SNAP
source.quote: We do not need waste, fraud and abuse in these programs.

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Whatley defended the 2025 law's Medicaid cuts
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Whatley wants market-driven replacements for the ACA
source.quote: We need to get the government out of the way

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Whatley supports the federal Education Freedom Tax Credit for private school scholarships
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Whatley welcomed the 2025 Border Patrol operation in Charlotte as strong, decisive action
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Whatley praised taking violent criminals who are here illegally off the street
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Whatley says he absolutely supports the Iran war
source.quote: very, very important from our national security perspective

source.title: guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Whatley supports the 2025 law extending the 2017 tax cuts
guides.vote, 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate voters guide: Whatley led the push for North Carolina's voter ID requirement and supports the SAVE America Act
